bullets.text: Active Exploitation Alert - **Microsoft Defender** warns of ongoing attacks exploiting **SolarWinds Web Help Desk** vulnerabilities.
Claude Opus 4.6 Launch - **Anthropic's** latest AI model is now available in **Microsoft Foundry** for enhanced coding and workflows.
New Clickfix Variant - The **CrashFix** variant deploys a **Python Remote Access Trojan** through browser disruptions.
Operation Winter SHIELD - **Microsoft** supports a new initiative to close the security implementation gap in organizations.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New build 28020.1546 released with improvements for **Windows Insiders**.
Enhanced Security Practices - **Microsoft SDL** adapts to address AI-specific security challenges in software development.
PostgreSQL Supercharged - **Azure** enhances **PostgreSQL** for AI applications, supporting developers with improved tools.
